headline: A data-native language prototype for reliable backend workflows and simulation-driven applications.

status.summary: Reux is demo-ready for public commerce, logistics, and Business Simulator testing, and prototype-complete for the current language/runtime foundation. The first sellable wedge is the Business Simulator: a guided operational scenario-planning product powered by Reux. The current language-core completion pass is closed; remaining work is product expansion, simulation depth, package distribution, and developer onboarding polish rather than closing the original MVP bar.

capabilityGroups.name: Commercial Productization
capabilityGroups.summary: The first sellable wedge is Business Simulator, aimed at teams that need operational scenario planning, saved results, and explainable recommendations.

capabilityGroups.name: Language Core
capabilityGroups.summary: The prototype language core can model schemas, enums, reusable typed queries, guarded transaction functions, durable events, migrations, and simulations.

capabilityGroups.name: Runtime And Database
capabilityGroups.summary: The runtime path uses PostgreSQL today and supports compiled query execution, transaction execution, migrations, seeds, and outbox processing.

capabilityGroups.name: Developer Experience
capabilityGroups.summary: The CLI, docs, package smoke checks, and editor tooling are ready for technical review and local experimentation.

capabilityGroups.name: Public Demo
capabilityGroups.summary: The hosted demo lets public users test commerce, logistics, and Business Simulator workflows with isolated visitor sessions, stable public error envelopes, public API rate limiting, request counters, generic Reux simulation execution, PostgreSQL-backed saved simulation runs, saved-run health checks, and maintenance cleanup tooling.

capabilityGroups.name: Pilots And Validation
capabilityGroups.summary: Commerce, logistics, clinic, PLOS, and business operations examples keep Reux grounded in real product needs.
